description: Returns the status and lifecycle events of a sandbox document sent from your getpeppr account; call it with the documentId send_test_invoice returned. submitted: getpeppr accepted it. delivered: the test receiver's access point received it, the goal of a sandbox test. failed: final, with a failureCategory. In application code, subscribe to webhooks instead of polling. Requires signing in to getpeppr.
name: get_document_status
title: Get a document's status
